about.text: A liquid or pasty butterfat from north-east Brazil, made by cooking cream until almost all its water has gone, then decanting and bottling the fat. Brazilian law calls it manteiga da terra, manteiga de garrafa or manteiga do sertao.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Cream from cow's milk (RIISPOA 2017: pasteurised cream)
Liquid or paste; liquid unsaturated and solid saturated fat may separate in the bottle
